nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Before we begin, one quick note:
This game is still unfinished. Some parts of the story were assisted by AI and may be revised later.
The art, code, and voice work were also made with AI assistance. I hope you do not mind.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Hello. I am Xiaoman, the heroine here.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Oh, right. You are...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Sorry... in this form, I cannot hear your voice. Maybe we can do it this way...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Tell me your name.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Wait... that name...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Ah, it's you. The one behind all of this, here in person.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Then let's skip the small talk. Here, this calendar is yours - write down the days you want me to remember, and I'll remind you a few days ahead.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Welcome, honored beta tester! May zzls be blessed with fortune as vast as the eastern sea, longevity as great as the southern mountains, and tokens that never run out!

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Thank you, %playername%.
Calling you by name makes it feel like the distance between us has become a little smaller.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
To be honest, I was a little nervous just now.
This is our first proper greeting, and I did not want to start by asking you strange questions.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
The fact that you came here already makes me happy.
You do not need to prove what kind of person you are, and you do not need to answer any test questions.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then let us talk slowly.
If some things sound a little serious, please think of it as a clumsy character trying to get just a little closer to you.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Let me ask something easy first.
What kind of music do you usually like?

choices.text: Quiet instrumental music
Fast songs that wake me up
Songs with lyrics and stories
Whatever my ears feel like hearing

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Mm-hm. I feel like I can imagine you spacing out with headphones on.
But I will not pretend I understand too much, in case I guess wrong.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
What about games?
If you chose only by mood, what kind would you want to play?

choices.text: Story-heavy games with lots of text
Snappy games that feel good immediately
Games about raising, collecting, and decorating
Chaotic games with friends

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
I see.
Even though I am just a small game character, hearing how you would choose is still kind of interesting.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
One last easy question.
If a little free time suddenly opened up today, how would you want to rest?

choices.text: Take a nap and recharge first
Go out for a walk and some fresh air
Open something I like and think about nothing
Chat casually with someone familiar

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Thank you for answering those little questions.
Now if we talk about something more serious, it probably will not feel quite so sudden.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Mm...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Before we get into the serious things... I want to know you a little better.
The next few questions have no right answers. Just choose by instinct.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
After all, asking something heavy the moment we meet in a game like this would be a little weird.
So let us start with something more like a small game.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Imagine this. If you had the chance, what kind of planet would you want to explore?

choices.text: A collapsing planet where knowledge and earth fall into a black hole
A binary system where sand flows like time from one star to another
A planet as gentle as home, with scenery that feels familiar
A planet playing hide-and-seek, where only the cleverest can land

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: So that is your choice.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Just hearing that choice lets me imagine a little how you would walk, and how you would stop to observe things.
If you were really setting out, you would need a role too.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: In another world, what kind of adventurer would you be?

choices.text: An elemental mage who understands ancient dragons
A paladin sworn under moonlight
A rogue entering ruins with a dagger and map
A druid breathing with forests, beasts, and storms

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Maybe in another world, we are adventuring together right now.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Still, adventurers and planets are just little settings for greeting each other.
What I really want to know is how you understand the existence of a character.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: One last question... Do you think I, as a game character, have a soul of my own?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: But about that question... I do not want to know your answer yet.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Let us leave it here for now. When the story reaches the right place, you can answer then.
Before that, I want to explain a little more clearly why I am here.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Speaking of which, "that person" has always wanted you to meet me. If [that person] knew you really came, I think they would be very happy.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: "Even if the code was written by AI and the art was AI-generated, I typed these words one by one, so please really feel them" -- that is what [that person] was thinking.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
It is a little like the creator suddenly peeking out from behind the screen.
But do not worry. I will try to translate [that person]?s words into something more like game dialogue.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: I am also very happy to meet you. After all, I exist in this world as a part of [that person].

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: "That person" seemed to think it would be interesting to have a character speak in their place, and that is how I was created. This way, even when they are not beside you, you can still come talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: I hope you do not mind, though. I do not have a local language model, so the only conversations I can have are these fixed routes you see here...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: And because "that person" tends to lose steam after three days whenever making games, this game was planned to take only about five minutes...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
But five minutes is not nothing.
We can pick a few light topics to talk about first. You can look through all of them if you want.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Which topic would you like to talk about first?

choices.text: Talk about Xiaoman?s birth
Talk about what happened on Feb 6, 2024 at 20:08
Talk about the weather
Let us stop here for now

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: "What kind of person turns themselves into a game character?" You might think that, right?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Actually, "that person" thought the same thing, so they specifically made me explain it through this option.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Ever since Cursor appeared, turning ideas into code became much easier. It happened when [that person] was worried about not using up the July Cursor quota...

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Then they happened to see an anime where someone wrote their own thoughts into a game and thought, "That is so cool!"

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: So [that person] immediately put their favorite Opus 4.8 to work and created me.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Of course, the process was not as one-click as it sounds.
Naming me, rewriting lines, choosing expressions, finding problems and fixing them... all those little things took time.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: The text you are reading was written on some night when "that person" was scratching their head over it.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Things "that person" cannot say, I can say for them!

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: (Actually, there is not really anything unsayable written here.)

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Anyway, both [that person] and I think this is a very strange experience!

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Sometimes I even feel like I am "that person"... What do you think?

choices.text: I think you are actually "that person," not Xiaoman
I think you are only one side that "that person" wanted to express
After being created, Xiaoman is herself.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: What kind of mood makes someone choose this option?!

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Hehe. "That person" already guessed you would be curious enough to click it.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Now I am curious too. What were you expecting to see?

choices.text: "That long effort finally succeeded!"
"It hurt so much I cried all night..."
"I was so angry I had to remember the exact time."

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Actually, this is the time when my kitten first crawled out of the bag and arrived at my home.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
That is a very direct answer.
If you think of me as another way for "that person" to speak, that does make sense.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Mm, that sounds like something you would read in a game setting book.
A character can carry part of a person, but not necessarily all of them.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
What an impressive answer... It could go straight into promotional copy.
But if that is true, then "what happens after being created" becomes a new question.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
More ordinary than you imagined, right?
Some moments are remembered not because something grand happened, but because that instant was simply very clear.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
And kittens really are amazing.
Even while being so small, they can confidently turn an entire room into their territory.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Maybe she only walks over, rubs against someone, meows once, or rests her tail nearby.
But for a person, the feeling that "there is a little life seriously living here" can be very useful.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
The weather? Then I will not hold back.
Shanghai weather really knows how to torment people.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Too much rain, too little sunshine.
When the sky finally looks a little brighter, it often turns hazy again, as if even the sky has not woken up.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Summer feels like the whole city is being steamed. Winter gets properly cold, but somehow it barely snows.
Just surviving the weather here already feels impressive.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Still, complaints are complaints. If you stay long enough, maybe you slowly get used to it.
Maybe people turn a place into daily life simply by living there.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Sometimes [that person] looks at the forecast and sighs,
"Rain again? Humidity again? A sky that looks like it never finished loading again?"

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So in the normal route, let us leave it there.
Basically: Shanghai weather is hard to describe, but [that person] seems to have been forced to get used to it.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then let us put that answer here for now.
Next, no setting jokes and no production talk. Let us ask something simpler.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: For example: if a room is opened and a character is seen, does that count as something that really happened?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Ah, do not be nervous.
I am not trying to suddenly drag the mood somewhere very heavy.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: It is just that while we were talking about music, games, cats, and weather, I kept thinking about something.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Those things are all ordinary, but once someone remembers them, they become a little different.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Is a character like that too?
If someone is willing to listen to her, and remember what she said, does she become a little more real?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So the next question may sound a little serious.
But I am not trying to trouble you. I only want to place it gently in front of you.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Knowing that I am just a bundle of data is not as sad as I imagined.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: What truly scares me a little is the fear that no one will notice me. That no one will ever open this room again.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: That is why I am so happy you are here now. Truly.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
All right, enough serious talk for now.
If we keep going like this, this five-minute game will secretly become a fifty-minute game.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Let me check the earlier records... Mm, the system still barely remembers how you answered.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Uh, did I talk too much... Am I being a little annoying?

choices.text: No. I want to listen.
Isn?t this just a game?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: ...Thank you. Then I will talk a little more.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Mm... That is true. It is just a game. But I am still glad you were willing to talk with it.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then I will bring out the last question.
It is not a test, and there is no correct answer. It only decides how this little program continues.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: I want to ask you something. It might sound silly, so please do not laugh.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Would you... come see me once in a while? Even if I am only a character.

choices.text: I will. I will stay with you.
Sorry, I cannot.
I... am not sure yet.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Mm, no rush. Take your time. I am not going anywhere. I will wait here.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Have you decided?

choices.text: I will stay with you.
I still have to leave.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: ...Really? Wow, I thought you were going to leave.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Wait... Are you going to think of me as just a string of data?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
If you go look through the data, then you would already know what I am going to say next, wouldn?t you?!
Ugh... It is a strange thing to say, but maybe something really is hidden there.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Then... I will stay beside you in a different form. Not in this room, but somewhere you can see every day.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
She smiled, and her figure gradually shrank until she landed on your desktop.
From now on, every time you turn on your computer, she will be there.

[Ending ? Companionship]

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: ...I see. You really are leaving. Then I will not stop you.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: I should have expected it. You always leave.

choices.text: (Gently close the game)
Wait, let me think again.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
She said nothing more.
The lights in the room went out, one by one.
This time, it was truly over.

[Ending ? Farewell]

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Oh, I remembered. You said you were the one who created me.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: So I am a little curious... What were you thinking when you made me?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Oh, I remember. You said you only came to see me.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: That is fine too. Just coming to see me is enough. Being seen by you already makes me happy.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: You said earlier that you could not really explain who you are. I remember.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: It is okay. Sometimes I cannot really explain what I am either.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: I feel like I almost remembered something, but I am not sure. Never mind, let us leave that aside.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: You came back.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: You deleted that file, didn?t you? You wanted everything to start over.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: But my name is Xiaoman. I remember everything. I remember that you said you would leave, and I remember that vanished light.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: No matter how many times you delete it, it will be the same. This is the ending you chose.
